question_text: A 31-year-old woman makes an appointment with a fertility specialist because she has not been able to conceive despite trying for over a year with her husband. She is concerned because her husband has 2 children from a previous marriage whereas she has no children. After obtaining a detailed history as well as lab tests, the specialist prescribes a certain drug. Interestingly, this drug is able to stimulate receptors in the presence of low hormone levels and inhibit the same receptors in the presence of high hormone levels. The drug that is most likely being prescribed in this case is associated with which of the following adverse events?
